newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee keeps gains, cocoa and sugar off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee keeps gains, cocoa and sugar off lows.

text.p: COFFEE - Barely moved by rallying NY prices and ends with morning gains. July/Sept active. July up $41 at $1,659.
COCOA - Ends down but off lows after July holds support at 980 stg. Light industry buying seen. July off six stg at 988 stg.
SUGAR - Recovers after earlier NY inspired falls. August 10 cents at $310.30 at 1604 GMT.
